integrity: Exact finite lemma checked from included Python standard-library file, plus a written universal analytical argument. Priority comparisons are supported by two inspected preprints and selected indexed mathematical results; independent replication is unperformed.
scientific_limitations: Only fair independent Bernoulli variables with n identical nonzero coefficients and one arbitrary real coefficient; no assertion for multiple exceptional coefficients, biased Bernoulli variables or the complete general conjecture. Small dimensions n<=19 use exhaustive exact integer arithmetic for a finite lemma.
title: Sharp endpoint Rényi comparison for one-exceptional-weight Bernoulli sums
